If you use the app in the browser, it is delivered via GitHub Pages (GitHub B.V., Netherlands / GitHub, Inc., USA). GitHub processes technically necessary access data such as the IP address. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR (secure provision of the website).

If you scan or enter a barcode, the product number is sent to Open Food Facts (Open Food Facts, 21 rue des Iles, 94100 Saint-Maur-des-Fossés, France) to retrieve nutritional values. For technical reasons your IP address is transmitted. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (providing the feature you requested).

If you take out a Premium subscription in the app from the Play Store or App Store, payment is handled exclusively by Google (Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland) or Apple (Apple Distribution International Ltd., Hollyhill Industrial Estate, Hollyhill, Cork, Ireland) under their own responsibility; we don't receive any payment or account data. To manage the subscription – checking whether Premium is active, renewal and restoring purchases – we use RevenueCat, Inc. (1032 E Brandon Blvd #3003, Brandon, FL 33511, USA) as a processor. This involves processing a random app user ID (if you take part in the leaderboard or have an account, your server ID), purchase and transaction data (product, purchase and expiry date, price, currency, store country), technical details such as operating system and app version, and the IP address. Processing takes place in the USA; the transfer is based on the EU standard contractual clauses. The legal basis is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (performance of the subscription contract) and, for statutory retention obligations, Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR. The app also stores locally on your device whether Premium is active. If you take part in the leaderboard, the server also stores whether Premium is active for you – this determines how many people your own friends groups can hold. There are no purchases and no transfer to RevenueCat in the web version.

If you store your own key for the Google Gemini API under “Photo analysis” and have a photo analysed, the photo is sent together with an instruction directly from your device to Google (Google Ireland Limited, Gordon House, Barrow Street, Dublin 4, Ireland; processing in the USA is also possible). Google processes the data under the terms you agreed with Google for your key. Your key is only stored on your device and is not included in backup files. The legal basis is your consent (Art. 6(1)(a), Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR), which you can withdraw at any time by deleting the key.

If you create an account under “Account & cloud”, we store your email address and password (only as an encrypted hash) on our server to sign you in, send you confirmation and password links and protect your account. We use an email service provider as a processor to send these emails. If you switch on cloud backup, a compressed copy of all app data – including health data such as weight, nutrition and training, but without the photo analysis key – is transferred and stored. It is replaced with each new backup. Server, processor and standard contractual clauses are the same as for the leaderboard (Supabase, data centre in Paris). The legal basis for the account is Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR (feature you requested), for cloud backup your explicit consent (Art. 6(1)(a), Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR). You can switch off and delete the cloud backup at any time or delete your account under “Account & cloud” – account, backup and leaderboard data on the server are then deleted immediately.
